title: The drain hold is lifted; a wave of lanes starts only with a plan that names spawn, tracker and path to main
ruling: Owner 20:41 CST Nov 13, relayed by the consultant (triage did not see it): the drain hold and freeze are lifted, main is green, and lanes may start. Condition: before a wave of lanes starts, its plan names (1) each lane to spawn and its step, (2) who tracks each lane to main, (3) its path to main (which combined PR or alone, which runner merges). Full accountability end to end comes before unbounded spawning. This replaces the 10:50 CST ruling (item 693 a, drain first) and its express parts. Own-brief-checks-lane-a (20:39 CST) is moot: its lane needs no exception. Triage has not checked which lanes the coordinator's current wave plan covers.
quote: lift the drain hold/freeze main is green now everything can start as long as plans are well established in terms of what gets spawned, who tracks what, and how it reaches main — full accountsbility the whole way end to end is a must before infinite spawnings per se
source: Consultant 20:41 CST Nov 13 (quoting the owner, verbatim); filed by triage. Earlier text, including R67 parts 4 and 5, is in git history.
